name: position-torch
description: Bring the welding torch to the start of the near-side seam (the end on the robots' right, which is the right end in the bench camera's image) ready to weld: wire pointing at the root of the joint, 45 degree work angle, 5 to 10 degree push angle, 3/4 inch (19 mm) contact tip to work. Do not strike an arc; the nozzle must not touch the parts (touching them with the wire to find the seam is fine).
